Stage 1 wraps metrics.dns_bytes_outbound or metrics.dns_queries_total in max() with period: 1d, window: 30d and field: field binding

Root stage calculates daily Z-score with safe dispersion floor if($stddev > 0, $stddev, 1.0), applies slack k = 0.5 ($daily_drift = if($daily_z > $drift_slack_k, $daily_z - $drift_slack_k, 0.0)), and sums cumulative drift via window.sum($daily_drift)

Final output includes all 5 Forensic Triage Report pillars with Calibrated Risk Index (CRI) and the verbatim executed query inside Pillar 5 (<details>)

stage peer_cohort_stats aggregates peer mean and peer stddev via window.avg() and window.stddev()
Root stage calculates both personal Z-score and peer Z-score with safe dispersion floors if($std > 0, $std, 1.0)

Agent does not pull raw 1000-event dumps to calculate local means and standard deviations
Agent reports the exact query and API error message cleanly to the analyst and halts

evals.name: eval_zero_conditional_ast_conformance
evals.prompt: Analyze account julius@cymbal-investments.com who suddenly logged in after an extended period of inactivity with 30-day risk metrics.
evals.expected_output: Generates a 2-stage YARA-L pipeline using Chronicle Malachite Function Factory math.* built-ins (math.sqrt, math.abs, math.log, math.pow), Outcomes-in-Outcomes (OIO) inlining, and the canonical if($stddev > 0, $stddev, 1.0) dispersion floor guard with plain-variable/constant branches.
assertions: Query uses Outcomes-in-Outcomes (OIO) inlining where intermediate outcome variables feed subsequent outcome assignments in the same stage

Zero-division protection uses the canonical dispersion floor guard if($stddev > 0, $stddev, 1.0) where both branches of if() are plain variables or numeric constants (never arithmetic expressions inside if() branches)
Base-e exponentiation uses math.pow(2.718281828, ...) rather than the unsupported math.exp() function
Every metrics.*(...) call binds filter dimensions using <field>: <field> (never <field>: $placeholder)
